finalText:
Build's green now, 0 errors. Two real bugs from the bundler bump, both fixed:

- `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `{ retryCount }`, so it crashed dereferencing `undefined`. Now reads `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it was throwing on every unset flag. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267 and a few `WARN W...` lines) are just deprecation noise from the version bump, not blocking anything — left those alone since they're cosmetic. Let me know if you want those chased down too.
